_what: 13 Oct 2026 (W14, D40): every figure the bulletin's "Is it a lot?" panel compares with that is not the scheme's own, each with its source, year and the day it was checked. Read by backend/comparisons.py and nowhere else; test_bulletin.py holds the panel to this table. Re-check each entry when its source publishes a new edition (next_edition).

car_kg_co2e_per_km.what: an average car, fuel unknown, tailpipe (Scope 1): the same tank-to-wheel basis as the lorry factors
car_kg_co2e_per_km.source: UK Government GHG conversion factors 2026 (DESNZ), flat file v1.2: Passenger vehicles > Cars (by size) > Average car > Unknown, km, kg CO2e (row 4_301_3074_4_1)

car_miles_a_year.what: the average annual mileage of a car in England, all cars, all fuels
car_miles_a_year.source: DfT National Travel Survey, table NTS0901a: Annual mileage of cars by fuel type, England (updated 10 September 2026)

car_range_pct.what: the car comparison is printed as a range, never one figure: the factor is a UK average for an unknown fuel and the mileage is England's
car_range_pct.source: Wayscope, decided by the user 13 Oct 2026 (D40)

la_road_transport.what: each local authority's road transport emissions (A roads, motorways, minor roads), territorial, from the government's local statistics; a month is taken as one twelfth of the year
la_road_transport.source: DESNZ, UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions statistics, 2005 to 2024, Table 1.1 (published 25 June 2026)
